summary: ShipmentNotificationOrchestration implements one request-response entry point. Every request receives an Accepted or Rejected acknowledgement when normal processing completes; only validated notices are subsequently sent to the FILE archive port.
mermaidCode:
flowchart LR
  A["Carrier HTTPS POST /notices"] --> B["XMLReceive"]
  B --> C["ShipmentNotificationOrchestration"]
  C --> D["ShipmentRules.IsValidNotice"]
  C --> E["DeliveryCalendar.EstimateDeliveryDate"]
  D --> F["Map Notice to Ack"]
  E --> F
  F --> G["ShipmentRules.AckStatus"]
  G --> H["HTTP ShipmentAck response"]
  D --> I{"isValid?"}
  I -->|Yes| J["FILE: Out/Shipments archive"]
  I -->|No| K["No archive"]
messageFlow: A carrier POSTs ShipmentNotice XML to /HarborLaneShipments/ShipmentService.svc/notices.
IsValidNotice checks shipment id, tracking-number length, and package-count range; EstimateDeliveryDate adds service-level business days while skipping weekends.
Map_ShipmentNotice_To_ShipmentAck copies identifiers and stamps UTC ReceivedAt; orchestration assigns Accepted/Rejected status and ETA.
ShipmentAck is returned on the two-way port.
After the reply, isValid == true causes the original ShipmentNotice to be written by SP_HarborLane_Shipments_Archive; rejected notices are not archived.

componentDetails.archiveBehavior: Only valid notices are archived, as the original ShipmentNotice XML, to SP_HarborLane_Shipments_Archive after the HTTP acknowledgement is sent. No retention or purge policy is evidenced.

gaps: External migration standards and extension resources are not configured.
Target public hostname, certificate, DNS, ingress, authorization, identity, and throttling equivalents are unresolved.
Target archive storage and lifecycle policy are unresolved.
No HTTP fault contract or terminal archive-failure handling is defined.

customCode.use: Validates shipment id, tracking number, and package count in Expr_ValidateAndComputeEta.
Computes the yyyy-MM-dd ETA using service-level business days and weekend exclusion.
Converts the validation Boolean to Accepted or Rejected in Assign_AckStatus.

transport.receive: WCF-WebHttp POST over Transport security, no client credential, XMLReceive
transport.response: XMLTransmit with a one-minute send timeout
transport.archive: FILE with XMLTransmit; 3 retries at 5-minute intervals
